commitment: Flashblock preconfirmation (~200ms sequencer sub-block); full L2 block ~2s; HARD Ethereum L1 finality ~15 min later
method: Real USDC ERC-20 self-transfer (0.000001 USDC), timed submit -> transaction receipt. Base streams Flashblock preconfirmations every ~200ms (sequencer sub-blocks), so the receipt an x402 client sees lands in ~200ms; the full L2 block is ~2s and hard Ethereum L1 finality is ~15 min later. Sent sequentially, one mined before the next.
